lastCompletedStory.title: Add the deterministic plan-runner driver (pick-issue, spawn planner, spawn auditor, read verdict)

nextStoryContext: US-005 added src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts with runPlanPhase(opts). Returns discriminated union: preflight-failed | no-plannable-issue | mutex-busy | planner-timeout | auditor-timeout | audit-approved | audit-blocked. All side effects injected (spawnFn, isPaneAlive, sleepFn, genUuid, selectIssueFn, readPlanVerdictFn, preflightFn, clock, plannerPaneId, paneCountMutexFn). genUuid() is .toLowerCase() (CAM-23). @cam_label set BEFORE respawn-pane. paneCountMutexFn is an injected closure (avoids session.ts/loop.ts SpawnFn type mismatch). Verdict read from plan-verdict-report.json ONLY (never capture-pane). 37 tests in test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner.test.ts. The next story (US-006) should wire runPlanPhase into the sidecar/loop or cam-plan flow and implement the post-audit actions (commit/branch/flip prd.json on audit-approved).

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-005 is purely internal: integrates plan-preflight.ts, plan-argv.ts, plan-verdict-report.ts, select.ts, loop.ts types, config/models.ts, and logging/spawn-resolution.ts. No external library API was exercised.
